Feature: System Backup and Authentication

  Background:
    # Background provides context for the various scenarios being tested
    Given the system is operational

  Scenario: Nightly full backup of the system
    # Scenario ensures that backups are taken and sent daily
    Given the current date is the last day of the month
    When the backup process is initiated
    Then the system should start backing up both the database and code
    And the backup should be sent to the remote site
    And the system should confirm the successful backup transmission
    And the backup history should show a record for today
    And the next backup should be scheduled for the following night

  Scenario: Password and login change for Doctors/Chemists
    # Scenario ensures that authorized personnel can change their credentials
    Given a Doctor/Chemist is logged in
    When they attempt to change their password
    Then they should be redirected to the password change page
    And they should be able to submit their new password
    And they should receive a confirmation of the password change

  Scenario: Patient registration with User-id/Password
    # Scenario ensures that new patients can register with their credentials
    Given a patient attempts to register
    When they provide a User-id and Password
    Then they should be registered
    And the system should authenticate them upon login

  Scenario: Doctor wise Appointment file generation
    # Scenario ensures that a report is generated for doctors' appointments
    Given the current date is within the next 5 days
    When the report generation is requested
    Then the system should provide a report detailing all appointments for the next 5 days

  Scenario: Speciality wise Consultations count
    # Scenario ensures that a report is generated for the number of consultations by specialty
    Given the current date is the last day of the month
    When the report generation is requested
    Then the system should provide a report with the number of consultations by specialty for the month/quarter/year

  Scenario: Speciality wise Revenue Earned report generation
    # Scenario ensures that a report is generated for revenue earned by specialty
    Given the current date is the last day of the month
    When the report generation is requested
    Then the system should provide a report with the revenue earned by specialty for the month/quarter/year

Feature: System Backup and Authentication
  Background: This feature verifies the backup and authentication functionalities as per requirements U32_13, VIRTUA-13-1, VIRTUA-13-2, and VIRTUA-13-3.

  # Verify system backup process
  Scenario: Nightly full backup of the system is taken and sent to the remote site
    Given the system is operational and the backup schedule is set for nightly execution
    When the end of the day is reached
    Then the system should initiate a full backup of both the database and code
    And the backup should be sent to the remote site
    And the backups should be rotated every 30 days

  # Verify password and login change for Doctors/Chemists
  Scenario: Doctors/Chemists can change their password and log in
    Given a Doctor/Chemist is logged into the system
    When they attempt to change their password
    Then they should be redirected to the password change page
    And they should be able to successfully update their password
    And they should be able to log in with the new credentials

  # Verify Patient registration and authentication
  Scenario: Patients can register and authenticate
    Given a patient attempts to register
    When they provide a User-id and Password
    Then they should be able to create a User-id and Password
    And they should be able to log in with these credentials

  # Verify report generation for Doctors
  Scenario: Doctor-wise Appointment report for next 5 days
    Given a Doctor requests the appointment report
    When the current date is within the next 5 days
    Then the system should generate a report showing all appointments for the Doctor for the next 5 days

  # Verify report generation for Speciality-wise Consultations
  Scenario: Speciality-wise Consultation count by Doctor
    Given a Doctor requests the consultation report
    When the current date is the last day of the month
    Then the system should generate a report showing the number of consultations by Doctor for the month/quarter/year

  # Verify report generation for Speciality-wise Revenue
  Scenario: Speciality-wise Revenue report
    Given a Doctor requests the revenue report
    When the current date is the last day of the month
    Then the system should generate a report showing the revenue earned by Doctor for the month/quarter/year
